role: Tile entity renderer for the enchanting table: the floating, bobbing book (ModelBook) above the table, opening and turning pages as the table's tile entity state animates.
scope_reason: In scope: TileEntityRendererDispatcher maps TileEntityEnchantmentTable to this renderer (TileEntityRendererDispatcher.java:52), so every placed enchanting table draws its floating, opening book from the tile entity's animation fields; world.conf enchanting = off does not stop the tile entity or this renderer.
notes: lane/idxclient: render_enchant_table is renderTileEntityAt whole: the table-centre translate, the bob on field_145926_a + pt, the turn interpolated the short way, the 80 degree tilt, the flip fractions through truncateDoubleToInt's floor ((int)(d + 1024) - 1024: a C cast truncates toward zero and posed the loose pages wrong on negative flips) and the interpolated spread; the book texture is csrc/assets/te/enchanting_table_book.rgba. Its inputs are the client's own TileEntityEnchantmentTable (play.c cbook_update, updateEntity on the client's split stream of field_145923_r, the client player as the reader), made when the table's block reaches the client world and first updated on the next row: an S21 chunk carries no tile entity and the client's is made by the chunk rebuild's lookup (Chunk.func_150806_e) in the next frame, so the oracle recording renders every tick (EVERY=1). idx-book-s1 matches the oracle's TileEntityRenderProbe book fields bit for bit at every tick and its 7 ticks' frames are within 14 to 59 px.
